name: matplotlib
title_zh: 逐像素掌控图表每一根线条的底层绘图库
tagline_zh: 当默认样式配不上你的论文时，直接接管坐标轴、刻度、色标和字体。适合做新图型、改细节、嵌进科研流程。
tagline_en: When defaults aren't good enough, take full command of axes, ticks, colormaps, and fonts. For novel plot types.
desc_en: Low-level plotting library for full customization. Use when you need fine-grained control over every plot element, creating novel plot types, or integrating with specific scientific workflows. Export to PNG/PDF/SVG for publication. For quick statistical plots use seaborn; for interactive plots use plotly; for publication-ready multi-panel figures with journal styling, use scientific-visualization.
why_zh: 它不替你决定任何视觉元素，所有对象都可编程访问。你要的是绝对控制权，它给的是从 figure 到 pa。
why_en: No hidden defaults — every visual element is a programmable object. You get the full object tree, from figure down to each.
limit_zh: 只认 Python 环境且需手动管理状态机；不负责统计计算、交互式探索或自动排版。多子图期刊模板请用 scientif。
limit_en: Python-only, manual state-machine management. No stats, no interactivity, no auto-layout. For journal templates use scientific-visualization; for.
